findings_to_judge.finding: lululemon's Q2 and FY26 guidance was set on 4 June 2026 and the release states it rests on 'management's expectations as of the date of this press release' - but the Great Wall drum crisis only went viral 11-13 days later (>50m Weibo views by 15 June, company apology 16-17 June), i.e. with roughly 7 of Q2's 13 weeks still to run, in the single segment (China Mainland, +30% revenue / +20% comp in Q1) that carries the entire growth story.

Alo Yoga opened its Tmall flagship on 12 August 2026 and did RMB 10m (~$1.4m) of sales in the first minute - a record opening day for a new brand in Tmall's sports and outdoor category - after entering mainland China in June 2026 via WeChat and Xiaohongshu with K-pop star Ningning as ambassador.

Chip Wilson, an 8.7% holder who spent 2025-2026 publicly attacking the board and running a proxy fight, has been bound since 26 May 2026 by an ~18-month standstill and non-disparagement covenant running to 30 days before the 2028 nomination deadline - so this is the first LULU earnings print in over two years at which he cannot amplify a bad number the next morning.
